metadata.case_name: CHAN KWEI DUEN v. EAST COUNTRY CO LTD T/A GOLD RIVER VIETNAMESE FOOD SHOP

source: X-ray examination showed mildly displaced facture of coccygeal spur.
X-ray taken of her lower spine revealed partial posterior dislocation of the coccyx without sign of bony facture and mild spondylosis at C5 and C6.
fracture of the coccyx is known to produce lasting pain and discomfort.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified fracture of lumbar spine or pelvis

manifestations.description: Localised tenderness over the Plaintiff’s lower back
Persistent discomfort at the injured area
Weakness in lower limbs and around the waist
Had to remain supine most of the time and could not sit up straight; could only sit for brief spells
Stomach discomfort caused by analgesic medication

treatments_received: Accident & Emergency treatment (Prince of Wales Hospital AED consultations)

losses.description: Pain and lasting discomfort in the coccyx / lower back region with associated functional limitation
Had to remain supine most of the time, limited ability to sit upright and only able to walk short distances at home

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: For the first 3 months after the accident the Plaintiff stayed at home and had reduced capacity to perform household activities
